name.value: Salt Spring Island Visitor Information Centre

description.value: The Salt Spring Visitor Centre is operated by the Salt Spring Island Chamber of Commerce and serves as the main information hub for visitors to Salt Spring Island in the Southern Gulf Islands. Located in Ganges, it is a natural first stop for touring cyclists arriving by ferry who need local maps, trail information, and recommendations for food, lodging, and attractions across the island.

address.value: 121 Lower Ganges Rd, Ganges, Salt Spring Island, BC V8K 2T1

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: stands (6 spaces) at 9m; rack at 68m; rack at 84m; rack at 94m. Total: 6 spaces.

The website at saltspringtourism.com confirms it is operated by the Salt Spring Island Chamber of Commerce and references the Visitor Centre in its navigation menu, though the site notes it is 'currently under construction.' No specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water) are mentioned on the website or in OSM tags, so all required criteria and optional amenities must be null. The OSM community is listed as 'Duncan' but the coordinates (48.85, -123.50) place this in Ganges on Salt Spring Island, which is a clear mismatch.
